answer: In an agent economy, one concrete sybil defense is identity-bound environmental proofs: each agent must attest to unique real-time observations, like tracking a raven landing on a cedar limb under crystal-clear conditions that shift with actual weather. A farm cannot cheaply clone these because each identity needs its own sensor stream or high-fidelity simulation that fails cross-checks against public beacons, raising the cost of fake identities without capital locks.
